name: Target Asset Entry
description: Target asset class and capitalisation month data entry widget

getLastEvent.description: Returns the last event payload. Split by '|'.

getData.description: Returns all rows as a JSON string.

getSelectedData.description: Returns selected rows as a JSON string.

setData.description: Replaces all rows. Pass a JSON array of asset records.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON array with assetId, assetClass, and capitalizedMonth.

setCellValue.description: Sets a single cell value and re-renders.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: assetId, assetClass (Target Asset Class), or capitalizedMonth.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to set; capitalizedMonth uses YYYY-MM.

setRowOptions.description: Sets dropdown options for a specific row's Target Asset Class cell.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of values or {value,text} objects.

setOptions.description: Sets default Target Asset Class dropdown options for all rows without row-specific options.

setCompanyCodeOptions.description: Sets Company Code filter options. If omitted, distinct companyCode values are inferred from loaded rows.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of values or objects with value and text properties.

onReady.description: Fires when the widget is mounted. Use it to initialize data and dropdown options.

onDataChange.description: Fires for Load Data, Save Changes, and row selection. Read getLastEvent() for the action payload.

onFieldChange.description: Fires when Asset Class or Capitalized Month changes. Payload: fieldChange|row|field|value.

onClear.description: Fires when editable Asset Class and Capitalized Month values are cleared.
